denormImg: create a function that denormalizes a PyTorch image tensor back to a uint8 numpy array for display
visSMPLoutput_bboxSpace: build a visualization of SMPL mesh and skeleton in bounding-box space using glViewer
getSMPLoutput_bboxSpace: extract SMPL body mesh vertices and joint positions from model prediction output in bbox space
getSMPLoutput_imgSpace: convert SMPL mesh and joint coordinates from bounding-box space to original image pixel space
renderSMPLoutput_merge: merge skeleton, mesh, and side-view render frames into composite images and encode an MP4 video
